title: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
provenance: Reported by tepliy (highball-db#82, 2026-09-16), Apple M5, macOS 27, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, rated 5 of 5 after 329 minutes. Graphics mode not stated. Not verified by the maintainer. A second report by HNKNTA (highball-db#315, 2026-10-04), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.3, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r15 with DXMT, Windows 11 set in the environment, rated 4 of 5 after 95 minutes, with fullscreen issues the report does not describe further. Reported by Sicks3c (highball-db#451, 2026-10-11), Apple M4 Max, macOS 26.6.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 65 minutes.
notes: Reported perfect over a five and a half hour session on an M5 on the default engine, the longest single report in the database, so this covers real play rather than the opening; the graphics mode was not stated. A second player on an M4 Pro put 95 minutes into it on the Wine 11 engine with DXMT and rated it playable, with fullscreen issues they did not describe further. No measurement here yet. A player rates it perfect after an hour on an M4 Max on DXMT.

knownIssues.symptom: Fullscreen issues, not described further, on the Wine 11 engine with DXMT
knownIssues.cause: Reported once (an M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, x64-crossover26.3-r15); the first report, on the default engine, said nothing of the kind. Not reproduced here.
knownIssues.fix: None recorded. A borderless window mode in the game's settings, if it offers one, is the thing to try.
